question: National Rifle Association of India was founded in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Rifle Association of India was founded in** 1951.**
 
• It is to promote and popularize shooting sports in India.
 
• The first speaker of Lok Sabha, **Sh. G.V. Mavlankar was the founder.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• The National Rifle Association of India (NRAI) has nominated rifle ace Anjum Moudgil __for the Khel Ratna - the country's highest sporting honour.
 
• NRAI also recommended Jaspal Rana for the Dronacharya Award for the second year in a row.
